# Guided Tours

### Guided Tour of the Temporary Exhibition "Germaine Richier" in Andros

The Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation provides Greek language guided tours of the exhibition [***"Germaine Richier"***](https://goulandris.gr/en/exhibition/germaine-richier), presented at the Museum of Contemporary Art in Andros.

Visitors can buy their tickets online at goulandris.gr, as well as at the Museum's ticket office (subject to availability).  

**Days & Times (Guided Tours in Greek)**  
**From Saturday August 1 to Sunday August 16, 2026:**  
Daily except Tuesday | 12.00-12.40

**Duration:** approximately 40’  

**Number of participants**: At least 3 people  
*\* If the minimum number of participants (3 persons) is not met, the ticket will be converted into an open ticket, valid for one year, allowing participation in the same or a similar guided tour on a date of the visitor’s choice.*  
*** Visitors participating in the Guided Tours are advised to be at the Museum 15΄ before the tour starts.*

# Group Visits

Groups of more than 10 people are welcome in our Museum of Contemporary Art in Andros, once request have been submitted in advance. The Foundation can organize and provide guided tours for an additional cost.

Book your visit in advance. Contact us at [**+30 22820 22444**](tel:+302282022444) or at **<andros@goulandris.gr>**

Guided tours are exclusively performed by the Basil and Elise Goulandris Foundation staff.

**Guided tour duration:** 40’  

******* **Participants are advised to be at the Museum 15΄ before the tour starts.**

# Access

### Arrival in Chora

![Icon Boat](https://s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/static1.goulandris.gr/icon-boat.svg)

Ferry routes to Andros

Regular daily ferry service, possibility for round trip/same day visit to the island  

- From the port of Rafina (travel time about 2 hours)
- From the island of Tinos (travel time about one and a half hours)
- From the island of Mykonos (travel time about two and a half hours)

![Icon Bus](https://s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/static1.goulandris.gr/icon-bus_180419_233500.svg)

From the port of Andros Island to Chora

From the port of Gavrion, where ferries arrive, you can reach Chora, where the Museum is located, in about 45 minutes by bus service (departure times always correspond to ferry arrival times).

### Parking

![Icon Car](https://s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/static1.goulandris.gr/icon-car_180419_233501.svg)

The Museum does not have a private parking area since it is located within the traditional settlement of Chora. Therefore, we advise visitors to park their car in one of the two municipal parking areas at the edge of the town or at the beginning of the Neimporio beach.

### People with Disabilities

![Icon Amea](https://s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/static1.goulandris.gr/icon-amea_180419_233459.svg)

The Museum’s Old Wing extends over three levels, which are accessible only by stairs. Due to the layout of the building, the visit may be difficult or not accessible for visitors with reduced mobility.

# Museum Spaces

## Shop

![Andros Shop 16 9](https://s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/static1.goulandris.gr/Andros-Shop-16-9.jpg)

The Museum Shop is located on the ground floor of the New Wing of the Museum. Visitors may purchase, silkscreens, art objects and jewelry, exhibition catalogues, posters, cards, t-shirts, etc.  

#### Opening Hours

The Museum Shop is open during the opening hours of the Museum  

#### E-Shop

Explore the e-shop of the Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation

[MORE](https://goulandris.gr/en/shop)

## Library

![Andros Library 16-9](https://s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/static1.goulandris.gr/Andros-Library-16-9.jpg)

The Museum’s library holds more than 5,000 books and also operates as a reading room during the opening hours of the Museum.  

#### Opening Hours

The Library is open during the opening hours of the New Wing

## Roof Garden

![Andros Doma 16 9](https://s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/static1.goulandris.gr/Andros-Doma-16-9.jpg)

The Roof Garden of the New Wing of the Museum of Contemporary Art, with a surface area of 180 sq.m., with an unhindered view of the Aegean, looks towards the picturesque beach of Nimborio, the Andros Yacht Club and the chapel of Agia Thalassini. It is ideal for hosting social events and cocktail parties which can be nicely combined with a tour of the Museum.
